AFE shield BOM, version 1 as built in kicad/design.py (D13, D15, D18, D19; D24-D27: AWG redone the v2 way, jumper ratio, BAV99 clamps; designators renumbered by block, 6 wall bridges and 3 REFCAL bridges; totals and cost lines below predate the 3 REFCAL bridges: +3 placements, +6 joints *(check)*), ordered domestically, 2026-11-12
Plain-text companion of whatif/bom.md; that file carries the sources, the cost breakdown, the cost by block and the flags. Generated from
kicad/design.py (the source of truth); kicad/check.py S4 holds this list equal to it, designator by designator.
Prices: JLC domestic (China) CNY ladders read from jlc-smt.com on 2026-11-12 for every Basic type that is new in version 1 over the
day (470k C23178, 300k C23024, 3.3k C22978, 4.99k C23046, 51k C23196, 100R 0603 C22775, 2.2k C4190, 22k C31850, 15k C22809, 3.9k
C23018, 13k C22797, BAV99 C2500, all read; the 0R C21189 (R109 / R110, R309 / R310, R515 / R516) was NOT read - an anti-bot challenge - and is priced at the 1R's ladder *(check)*; 100k, 330k, 75k, 1k, 270R, 100R 1206, 10 pF, 30 pF earlier) and for ADS1115 and TPH2502; the other
types keep the 2026-11-11 domestic ladders of the earlier bom.md *(check: not re-read)*. 'cny@20' = the tier holding 20 x qty pieces;
'cny@100' = the tier holding 50 x qty (100 boards are two orders of 50). CNY at 6.6912 per USD *(check)*. International totals are not
recomputed. Designators as drawn in the schematic: 1xx scope CH1, 2xx CH2, 3xx AWG, 4xx power, 5xx reference / calibration, 6xx board edge. BNCs, headers, the CAL header J501, standoff: owner-fitted, listed separately at the
end. Test points TP401-TP405 and TP501: not listed. AREF series 0R (PA-7, R510): one 0603 footprint, unfitted, no part, no fee. D18: no range switches.
D19: the scope is centred from the REF3030E (R104 / R204, 330k to VREF; no scope Vmid, no 3.3 V sense). D24-D27: the AWG is one TPH2502 half
with DAC0 into a divider and the offset from the REF3030E (whatif/v1-awg-ref/); the TMUX1119 ratio switch is gone, the ratio is
measured with a hand-fitted shunt on J501 (whatif/v1-jumper/, S3); every clamp is a BAV99 (C2500, Basic); R407 is 2.2k. Wall bridges: six 0603 0R of one type (0Rb, C21189), no 1206 0R exists: R515 / R516 (VREF to CH2), R309 / R310 (AWG_BNC sense), R109 / R110 (the scope's own +3V3A); the AWG's +3V3A, VNEG and offset VREF branches are not bridged (strip lanes under the header pads).

PROVISIONAL ITEMS
  (b) cut 4 (3157-class range switches) is moot: the range switches and the TMUX1119 ratio switch are gone (D18, D25).
  (c) scope C2 is one 30 pF C0G (C102, C202) from N to GND, C1 12 pF across R1 (C101, C201), Cnp 10 pF (C105, C203). Re-trim of the scope
  compensation in sim/scope: *(superseded figures: see whatif/v1-basic/values.md, whatif/tph2502/, budget/v1_scope_ref.py)*.
  REFERENCE OUTPUT: 100 nF (C503) and 1 uF (C504) are fitted at VREF; the REF3030E asks for 0.1-22 uF (SBVS032). VREF also feeds the
  scope centres (R104, R204), the AWG offset filter (R307 into 2 x 10 uF) and Rd (R512): the load is *(check at VT)*.
  AWG (whatif/v1-awg-ref/design.md): 112 of 115 rows pass in that note, 3 are open decisions *(check)*.
  SENSE (whatif/v1-jumper/design.md): ratio 0.088 % / 0.307 % (tracking / independent) against a 0.05 % allotment: gain term fails;
  whole SC-7 stack passes on tracking *(check)*. The silicon BAV99 on the ADS1115 inputs: -0.3 V row, VT-22 *(check)*.

PULL RESISTORS AND BLEED (bom.md "Control-pin pull resistors"): no Due control pin is driven (D9 and the TMUX1119 gone). I2C: R509
(SDA1) and R511 (SCL1), 4.7k to +3.3 V_A; the Due has none on those nets (V03). R407, the +3.3 V_A bleed, is 2.2k (was 4.7k) for PR-3
(whatif/v1-jumper/design.md section 8): 1.57 mA permanent, +0.84 mA over the 4.7k.
PENDING: IC decoupling one 100 nF per supply pin (C103 U101, C302 / C303 the AWG TPH2502, C401 LM27762, C501 REF3030E, C502 ADS1115). ADS1115
ties, no parts: ADDR to GND (0x48), ALERT/RDY open.
STOCK: not read (the domestic record shows 0 for every part) *(check before ordering, ADS1115 and TPH2502 first)*.

  slightly higher *(check the mated gap)*. Nearest standard: 8 mm, shimmed; 10 mm would lift the shield off its sockets.

  International grand totals: not recomputed.
  SPI0 (2x3) not fitted: the ADC is the I2C ADS1115 on SDA1/SCL1 (PWMH0.9/.10), so MC-1's SPI0 connection is not needed.
  BNC straight or right-angle is not stated in docs/afe.md; MC-8's "one board edge" implies right-angle (owner to confirm).
  JLC/LCSC catalogue headers (Samtec SSQ + cut PC104) not used: too little stock, mixed 10 / 12.2 mm tails, 9.72 / 8.56.

PIN CHECK (V03 board nets, hardware/reference/arduino-due/v03/Arduino-DUE-V03.kicad_pcb; firmware grep of drivers/ lib/ sketches/ apps/ bsp/)
  SDA1 PWMH0.9 (U1 pad 9)  ADS1115 SDA, 4.7k pull-up R509 to +3.3 V_A  (the SAM3X's TWI0, not TWI1)
  SCL1 PWMH0.10 (U1 pad 70)  ADS1115 SCL, 4.7k pull-up R511 to +3.3 V_A
  Only these two Due digital pins are used; no control pin is driven. Gone with D18 / D15 / D19 / D25: D9 (ratio switch SEL), D16 and
  D39 (range selects), D5-D8 (SPI), the Due 3.3 V sense pin (POWER0.4). D5-D9, D16, D33-D41 and every XIO0 pin are free.
  No clash: each net reaches only its U1 pad and the header pad (SDA1: U1 pad 9 and PWMH0 pad 9; SCL1: U1 pad 70 and
  PWMH0 pad 10), so the Due has no pull-up on either. The firmware does not touch TWI, PA17 or PA18 (grep) and never
  touches port C except the RX LED. Whether Track A's Arduino core init() enables a TWI on these pins is *(check)*.

BOARD OUTLINE (V03 board file; origin lower-left, Y up, mm)
  Due: 101.6 x 53.34 bounding; right edge x 99.06 with a nose to 101.6 between Y 5.08 and 37.85.
  Headers (pad centres): POWER0 x 27.94-45.72, ADCL0 50.80-68.58, ADCH0 73.66-91.44, all Y 2.54;
  PWMH0 x 18.796-41.656, PWML0 45.72-63.50, COMMUNICATION0 68.58-86.36, all Y 50.80;
  XIO0 x 93.98 / 96.52, Y 7.62-50.80. SPI0 (not used) x 63.627 / 66.167, Y 25.40-30.48.
  Header bodies span x 17.53-97.79, Y 1.27-52.07: a shield of <= 100 mm in X and Y reaches all of them.
  Due left side (STEP models, z from Due top): barrel jack X -1.88-12.32, Y 3.2-12.8, 11.0 tall; micro-B J3 Y 18.2-26.3,
  2.75; micro-AB USB1 Y 34.0-42.2, 2.81; Due sockets 8.47 = shield underside height.
  BNCs on the left edge (x 17): their pins clear the jack by 4.7 mm, but the barrels (from ~10.1 mm up) can hit
  the 11.0 mm jack if they overhang to x <= 12.3, and all plugs leave to the left. KH-BNC50-3511 drawing not
  readable *(check)*.
  PROPOSED: x 17.0-117.0, Y 0-53.34 = 100.0 x 53.34 mm, BNCs on the right edge (19.2 mm past XIO0's body),
  overhanging the Due by 15.4 mm; add a standoff at (96.52, 2.54) or (90.17, 50.8). The 82.06 x 53.34 outline
  (x 17.0-99.06) applies only if the BNCs stay on the left (at most two, Y 14-47).
  JLC 100 x 100 mm price break: not read *(check)*; PCB price at 20 / 100 not read *(check)*.
